games:2026-wk11-usc-indiana.blurb: No. 15 USC heads to No. 6 Indiana as a 7.5-point underdog with ESPN giving the Hoosiers a 78% shot. The Trojans are chasing their way into the field, and few résumé wins available anywhere are bigger than this one.

games:2026-wk11-utah-arizona.blurb: No. 2 Utah is only a 2.5-point favorite at No. 22 Arizona, the kind of line that says this one is live. The Utes lead the Big 12 race, so a road loss here reshuffles everything at the top.

games:2026-wk11-wake-forest-smu.blurb: No. 11 Wake Forest goes to No. 25 SMU as a 1.5-point favorite with a juicy 61.5 total. The Demon Deacons are the ACC's closest chaser, and they need every win to keep pace.

games:2026-wk11-illinois-ucla.blurb: No. 4 UCLA hosts Illinois as a 10-point favorite with ESPN giving the Bruins a 74% shot. UCLA holds the Big Ten lead and can't afford to let an unranked visitor hang around.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-oregon-state-b.blurb: No. 17 Boise State hosts Oregon State as a 13.5-point favorite with an eye-catching 65.5 total. ESPN gives the Broncos an 81.6% shot to keep rolling.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-baylor-byu.blurb: No. 12 BYU welcomes Baylor as a 7.5-point favorite and a 68.5% pick in ESPN's model. The Cougars are the first team outside the field, so style points matter.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-texas-tech-okl.blurb: No. 10 Texas Tech is a 3.5-point underdog at Oklahoma State in a game with a 72.5 total -- expect points. The Red Raiders are chasing Utah in the Big 12, making this a dangerous road trip.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-michigan-orego.blurb: No. 18 Oregon hosts Michigan as an 11.5-point favorite with a stingy 38.5 total suggesting a defensive afternoon. ESPN gives the Ducks an 85.9% shot at home.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-duke-miami.blurb: No. 5 Miami lays 13.5 against Duke with ESPN putting the Hurricanes at 88%. Miami leads the ACC race and should treat this as business as usual.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-purdue-iowa.blurb: No. 16 Iowa is a 16.5-point favorite over Purdue, the biggest spread on the Hawkeyes' slate in a while, and ESPN backs it at 87%. A get-right spot if there ever was one.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-tennessee-texa.blurb: No. 9 Tennessee heads to College Station as a 2.5-point favorite, with ESPN's model giving the Vols a 58.6% shot in what projects as a grinder at a 43.5 total. A road win keeps Tennessee's résumé humming; a slip to an unranked Texas A&M is the kind of result that lingers in November.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-alabama-vander.blurb: No. 7 Alabama is a 15.5-point favorite at Vanderbilt, and ESPN pegs the Tide at a 94.8% chance to handle it. With a 50.5 total, the real question is whether Alabama covers comfortably enough to keep climbing in the SEC pecking order.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-boston-college.blurb: No. 3 Notre Dame lays 29.5 against Boston College with ESPN giving the Irish a 98.5% shot. This is about avoiding a scare, not surviving one.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-south-carolina.blurb: No. 20 South Carolina is a 7.5-point favorite at Arkansas with ESPN putting the Gamecocks at 77.2%. A road win keeps their climb going.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-missouri-georg.blurb: No. 1 Georgia hosts Missouri as a 15.5-point favorite and an 88.8% pick by ESPN. The Bulldogs lead the SEC race and have the cushion to prove it.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-unlv-new-mexic.blurb: No. 23 New Mexico lays 14 at home against UNLV with ESPN giving the hosts an 86.7% shot. The newly ranked Lobos need to keep protecting their home field.

predictions:boise-state.blurb: Boise State jumped from No. 25 to No. 17, though the metrics remain skeptical of the Pac-12 riser at 26th in SP+ and 33rd in FPI.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA climbed to No. 4 from No. 8, and while SP+ is on board at 11th, FPI is a tougher sell at 27th.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: The Big Ten's auto bid is the tightest race in the sport: No. 4 UCLA leads with No. 6 Indiana just two spots behind. Every Saturday from here is effectively a tiebreaker.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: The SEC's automatic bid isn't much of a race right now: No. 1 Georgia sits six spots clear of No. 7 Alabama, the closest thing to a chaser. The Tide need help as much as they need wins to close that gap.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 5 Miami controls the ACC's automatic bid with No. 11 Wake Forest six spots back. The Deacs can't just keep winning -- they need the Hurricanes to slip.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: Utah's grip on the Big 12 is the firmest of the four leagues: the No. 2 Utes are eight spots clear of No. 10 Texas Tech. Only a Utah loss really opens this up.

bubbleNotes:usc.blurb: USC surged five spots to the No. 16 seed but still sits four spots outside the field -- and the next test is a trip to No. 6 Indiana. Win that and the math changes in a hurry.

bubbleNotes:byu.blurb: BYU slipped three spots to the No. 13 seed, leaving the Cougars first team out and one place from the field. The margin for error is gone.

games:2026-wk11-florida-kentucky.blurb: No. 13 Kentucky lays just 3.5 at home against an unranked Florida team ESPN still gives a 46% shot, so the Wildcats' margin for error is thinner than the ranking suggests. With a total of 52.5, this looks like the kind of coin-flip night that can swing Kentucky's whole postseason case.

games:2026-wk11-texas-lsu.blurb: No. 8 Texas heads to Baton Rouge as a 4-point underdog to No. 24 LSU, with ESPN's model splitting it nearly down the middle at 52.6-47.4. The 46.5 total points to a grinder, and a Longhorns slip here would be the kind of loss that reshuffles the top of the SEC picture.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-ole-miss-oklah.blurb: No. 19 Ole Miss is a 1.5-point favorite in Norman, roughly a 57% play by ESPN's numbers against an unranked but dangerous Oklahoma side. Total of 49.5 suggests neither defense is expected to fully lock things down.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-northwestern-o.blurb: No. 21 Ohio State is a 12.5-point favorite over Northwestern at home, with ESPN giving the Buckeyes an 85.5% win probability. With a 45.5 total, this is a game Ohio State needs to win cleanly rather than survive.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk11-houston-colora.blurb: No. 14 Houston goes to Boulder favored by 10 and carrying an 83% win probability in ESPN's model. The Cougars are climbing, and a tidy road win over Colorado keeps that momentum intact.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky took a steep tumble from No. 6 to No. 13, and the advanced numbers aren't exactly rushing to the rescue -- 41st in SP+ and 35th in FPI. The Wildcats need results to start matching the ranking.

predictions:lsu.blurb: LSU slid from 14th to 24th in the polls, but the metrics love them anyway: seventh in both SP+ and FPI. That's a team the rankings may be undervaluing.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State dropped nine spots to No. 21 despite sitting third in SP+ and fifth in FPI. By the analytics, the Buckeyes are still playing like a top-five team.

bubbleNotes:houston.blurb: Houston jumped three spots to the 15 seed, trending in the right direction but still three spots outside the field. The Cougars are close enough that one more clean weekend changes the conversation.

bubbleNotes:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky tumbled seven spots to the 14 seed and now sits two spots shy of the field. The Wildcats have gone from comfortable to firmly on the bubble, and the arrow is pointing the wrong way.
